name: driver
description: Connects a param to a pose (like a Moho smart bone, but explicit): the param's value, within the span inMin…inMax, becomes the pose's weight, from outMin to outMax (0 = not noticeable, 1 = the full pose). Several active poses add up on top of the setup. With an enum param, equals says which option puts the pose at 100%.
help: Connects a parameter to a pose, like a Moho smart bone: the parameter value becomes the weight of the pose.

inMin.help: Parameter value where the weight is outMin. Can be greater than inMax (for the negative side of a turn).
inMin.description: Param value where the weight is outMin. Can be greater than inMax (for the negative side of a turn: inMin 0, inMax -1).

inMax.help: Parameter value where the weight is outMax.
inMax.description: Param value where the weight is outMax.

outMin.help: Weight at the start of the range.
outMin.description: Weight at the start of the span.

outMax.help: Weight at the end of the range.
outMax.description: Weight at the end of the span.

equals.help: Enum parameters only: the option that shows the full pose (any other option gives weight 0).
equals.description: Enum params only: the option with which the pose is applied in full (with the other options, weight 0).
